label: TP
reason: User-supplied cookie value flows through URL decoding into a variable used directly in a string concatenation within encodeForHTML output sent to the HTTP response stream. Although ESAPI encoder is applied, the decode operation does not sanitize HTML entities, allowing script execution via encoded payloads.

evidence.note: User cookie value retrieved and decoded without proper HTML escaping
Decoded value concatenated into response output without effective neutralization of XSS vectors
